db.description:
The database index of redis server to be used(Must be less than 10).
@Environment `REDIS_DATABASE`

host.description:
The host of the redis server.
@Environment `REDIS_HOST`

port.description:
The port of the redis server.
@Environment `REDIS_PORT`

username.description:
The username of the redis server.
@Environment `REDIS_USERNAME`

password.description:
The password of the redis server.
@Environment `REDIS_PASSWORD`

ioredis.description: The config for the ioredis client.

apolloDriverConfig.description: The config for underlying nestjs GraphQL and apollo driver engine.

name.description: A recognizable name for the server. Will be shown when connected with AFFiNE Desktop.

https.description:
Whether the server is hosted on a ssl enabled domain (https://).
@Environment `AFFINE_SERVER_HTTPS`

port.description:
Which port the server will listen on.
@Environment `AFFINE_SERVER_PORT`

path.description:
Subpath where the server get deployed if there is.
@Environment `AFFINE_SERVER_SUB_PATH`

privateKey.description:
The private key for used by the crypto module to create signed tokens or encrypt data.
@Environment `AFFINE_PRIVATE_KEY`

queues.copilot.description: The config for copilot job queue

queues.doc.description: The config for doc job queue

queues.notification.description: The config for notification job queue

queues.nightly.description: The config for nightly job queue

throttlers.default.description: The config for the default throttler.

throttlers.strict.description: The config for the strict throttler.

transports.description: The enabled transports for accepting websocket traffics.

maxHttpBufferSize.description: How many bytes or characters a message can be, before closing the session (to avoid DoS).

requireEmailDomainVerification.description: Whether require email domain record verification before accessing restricted resources.

requireEmailVerification.description: Whether require email verification before accessing restricted resources(not implemented).

passwordRequirements.description: The password strength requirements when set new password.

session.ttl.description: Application auth expiration time in seconds.

session.ttr.description: Application auth time to refresh in seconds.

SMTP.description:
The SMTP configuration for the mail service.
@link https://nodemailer.com/smtp/

experimental.yocto.description: Use `y-octo` to merge updates at the same time when merging using Yjs.

history.interval.description: The minimum time interval in milliseconds of creating a new history snapshot when doc get updated.

avatar.publicPath.description: The public accessible path prefix for user avatars.

avatar.storage.description: The config of storage for user avatars.

blob.storage.description: The config of storage for all uploaded blobs(images, videos, etc.).
